records.title: Progressive Gradient Flow for Robust N: M Sparsity Training in Transformers
records.reason: Progressive gradient flow is a training procedure for robust N:M sparsity in transformers; reported work addresses sparse pretraining rather than inference-time execution, so downstream serving benefit remains unestablished.

records.title: Mesa: A Memory-saving Training Framework for Transformers
records.reason: Mesa reduces memory use during Transformer training through a memory-saving framework; its target is training activation/memory cost, not inference serving or model compression at deployment.

records.title: Sparse Logit Sampling: Accelerating Knowledge Distillation in LLMs
records.reason: Sparse Logit Sampling reduces teacher-logit work for LLM knowledge distillation; the optimization is a training/distillation pipeline and does not reduce deployed model inference cost.

records.title: SEEKR: Selective Attention-Guided Knowledge Retention for Continual Learning of Large Language Models
records.reason: SEEKR uses selective attention-guided knowledge retention for continual LLM learning; its focus is preserving knowledge across updates rather than reducing inference resources, and no serving improvement is established.

records.title: Parameter and Computation Efficient Transfer Learning for Vision-Language Pre-trained Models
records.reason: The method reduces parameters/computation for vision-language transfer learning, with computational savings tied to adaptation/training; it is not shown as an inference-serving optimization for LLMs.
